items.title: Matthew Stafford: Modest numbers in Week 12 win
items.body_text: Stafford completed 16 of 23 passes for 141 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. He also committed a fumble recovered by Los Angeles. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Love: Struggles against Rams in loss
items.body_text: Love completed 17 of 29 passes for 198 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Inefficient night in loss
items.body_text: Golden secured one of five targets for 39 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Limited to three catches in loss
items.body_text: Kraft brought in three of five targets for 24 yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night. He also lost a fumble. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Completely overshadowed by Corum
items.body_text: Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
